unresolved.status: No habitual DBZ charge aura hue established in the inspected sources
unresolved.proposal: A neutral white/light aura would be an adaptation choice for the game, not a confirmed exclusive anime colour
unresolved.context: The official character profile describes her perpetual energy reactor. Official HDBZ screenshots inspected show attacks and poses, not a comparable charge aura.

limits: Colours vary by scene, lighting, remaster and technique. These are visual colour families, not official hex swatches.
Downloaded frames were inspected; image-search generated captions were not treated as evidence.
Some search results were from Super, fanart, AI art, mods or attacks: those were not used to establish ordinary DBZ charging colours.
Native Buyuu shared gold palette remains unchanged in the current no-rays ROM.
